jobs.description:
**Location:** San Diego, CA (Hybrid – must be local) | **Type:** Full-time

**About Navaide**

Navaide partners with federal clients to deliver mission-focused solutions across financial management, ERP, and digital transformation. We bring deep domain expertise, practical execution, and a people-first culture to complex government environments.

**Catalysts for a Stronger Tomorrow**

At Navaide, we exist to empower organizations to evolve and adapt in a rapidly changing world. By combining human ingenuity with transformative technology, we develop innovative solutions that drive progress for the people and systems that strengthen our nation. Our mission is rooted in agility, scalability, and a commitment to exceeding expectations, ensuring impactful results for our clients and communities.

**How You Will Make an Impact:**

We are seeking a proactive, mid-to-senior Data Science / AI Analyst to accelerate the adoption of generative AI, intelligent agents, and process automation for a Navy enterprise IT organization in San Diego. You will partner with senior technical leadership to identify AI capability gaps, help shape a multi-year AI enablement strategy, and build working prototypes that demonstrate measurable operational value.

This is not a traditional dashboard developer role. The successful candidate is a self-starter who blends hands-on engineering with strategic advisory work, engages directly with stakeholders, and delivers results with limited oversight. The role will grow as the organization's AI maturity grows.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assess current and future AI capability gaps and develop technical papers, roadmaps, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations for leadership.
* Take in, evaluate, and prioritize proposed AI use cases, and drive the highest-value ones from concept through delivery.
* Evaluate commercial and open-source AI technologies, including large language models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms, through market research, proofs of concept, and migration planning.
* Design, build, and test AI agents, retrieval-augmented knowledge bases, and workflow automations in secure, accredited cloud and generative AI environments.
* Develop AI-enabled capabilities such as natural language querying, automated leadership summaries, document analysis, and decision-support recommendations.
* Validate AI-generated outputs against source data, business rules, and subject matter expert feedback.
* Develop the data pipelines, integrations, and data quality controls that AI solutions depend on.
* Help establish standards for AI governance, risk management, data quality, documentation, and responsible AI use so solutions can scale.
* Partner with functional subject matter experts, data owners, and field innovation teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Represent the team in cross-organizational AI and data working groups.
* Deliver training and knowledge transfer that builds self-service AI and analytics capability across user communities.
* Present findings, prototypes, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of professional data science experience (mid level), or Master's degree and 10+ years (senior level), in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* U.S. citizen, eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government SECRET clearance.
* Must be local to San Diego and able to work on-site at a government facility on a regular hybrid schedule.
* Strong Python and SQL, including data pipeline development.
* Hands-on experience building LLM applications: retrieval-augmented generation, agents and tool use, prompt engineering, and output evaluation.
* Experience with Azure and/or AWS and data platforms such as Databricks.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, access control, and responsible AI practices.
* Ability to explain technical findings in plain language to senior military and civilian leaders.
* Ability to meet DoD cyber workforce qualification requirements (DoDM 8140.03).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Active SECRET clearance.
* Experience with GenAI.mil or other DoD-accredited generative AI environments.
* Experience across frontier model platforms, such as Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and OpenAI.
* Model Context Protocol or similar agent-integration standards.
* Advana, Jupiter, or similar federal/DoD data environments.
* Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) or MLOps.
* Tactical edge or disconnected-environment data tooling.
* DoD Responsible AI guidance and AI test and evaluation.
* Prior Navy experience.

**Location and Work Schedule**

This position is hybrid and requires candidates to be local to San Diego. The schedule combines remote work days with on-site days at a government facility in San Diego, based on mission needs. Standard Monday–Friday workweek, with occasional travel to other government sites.

**What We Offer**

Navaide is committed to fostering a supportive, inclusive, and forward-thinking workplace where our team members can thrive. Our benefits are designed to support your well-being, professional growth, and ability to work at a sustainable pace.

* Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience)
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Company perks such as flex spending, wellness initiatives, etc.
* 401(k) matching

**About Our Culture**

Navaide honors integrity, curiosity, diligence, and collaboration in everything we do. We believe in building strong relationships with our clients, communities, and teammates, united by a shared purpose of creating a stronger tomorrow. Navaide is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

The USC Alfred E. Mann School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Titus Family Department of Clinical Pharmacy, is seeking a Research Lab Technician II to support ongoing studies in immunogenomics, cancer genomics and therapeutics.

We are a translational genomics and experimental therapeutics lab focused on identifying and investigating novel therapeutic targets in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and developing new therapeutic strategies. We seek a highly motivated, detail-oriented individual to perform molecular, cellular, and in vivo experiments and support the day-to-day operation of the laboratory.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Process and run quality control on next-generation sequencing data (e.g., RNA-seq, whole-exome/genome sequencing, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, single-cell sequencing) using established pipelines
* Perform downstream analyses, including differential expression, variant calling and annotation, pathway enrichment, and clustering, under the guidance of the Principal Investigator and senior lab members
* Analyze data from high-throughput drug screens, flow cytometry, and preclinical mouse studies; perform basic statistical analyses
* Mine public ‘omics’ resources (e.g., TCGA, BeatAML, GEO, DepMap) to support target discovery and validation
* Maintain, document, and update analysis pipelines and scripts using version control
* Organize and manage lab datasets, sample metadata, and clinical annotations in compliance with IRB and data security requirements
* Run jobs on USC’s high-performance computing cluster and manage data storage
* Prepare figures, tables, and summaries of results for lab meetings, presentations, and manuscripts

**Minimum Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology, or a related field
* Hands-on laboratory experience with routine molecular biology and cell culture techniques
* Excellent organizational, record-keeping, and communication skills
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 1–2 years of experience in a bioinformatics or research data role
* Hands-on experience with NGS analysis tools (e.g., STAR, DESeq2, GATK, Seurat, Bioconductor packages)
* Experience with HPC/cluster computing (e.g., SLURM) and workflow managers (e.g., Snakemake, Nextflow)
* Experience with Git and reproducible analysis practices
* Background in cancer biology, immunology, or hematologic malignancies

**Applicants should attach the following:**

  

* Cover letter describing research experience and interests
* Résumé or CV

* Names and contact information for two to three references

Eurofins EAG Laboratories has over 40 years experience in engineering and materials testing services. If you’re energized by materials science, analytical chemistry, engineering rigor, and solving problems that matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our scientists and engineers support industries ranging from semiconductors and advanced electronics to pharmaceuticals, medical devices, energy systems, and consumer products. Using advanced techniques in analytical chemistry, microscopy, surface analysis, and engineering sciences, we help clients solve complex challenges across the product lifecycle.

What sets EAG apart isn’t just our world‑class instrumentation—it’s our people. We’re problem solvers, collaborators, and lifelong learners who value precision, curiosity, and impact. Here, your work directly influences the safety, reliability, and performance of products used around the globe.

Steel Traditions — Vista, CA | Full-time | Mon–Fri, 6:30 AM–3:00 PM  
Pay: $27/hr and up, based on experience  
  
About the role  
Steel Traditions builds custom steel windows and doors for high-end homes. As our Final Assembly & QC Technician, you are the last set of hands and eyes before a unit leaves the shop. You stand each unit up on our QC wall and fully install it as it will go in on site, including sliders, French doors and bifolds. You glaze, seal, put on the hardware and check every part. Then you wrap, package and load it to ship. Nothing ships until you've passed it. There is room to grow into a QC Wall lead role.  
  
What you'll do  

* Review the prints and shop drawings for every unit before hanging it.
* Stand up and install finished units on the shop QC wall, including French doors, sliders and bifolds, following the manufacturer's install order.
* Glaze units by setting the glass and running silicone on both sides, then clean the units.
* Install hardware: handles, hinges, sweeps, cylinders, shoot bolts and hardware boxes. Adjust parts and make small fixes when something doesn't fit.
* Hold the line on quality: no unit ships with damage, scratches or paint defects. If it isn't right, tag it HOLD and tell the fab lead and the office the same day.
* Check every part thoroughly: function, operation, finish/color against the order, glass, seals and hardware. Fill out the QC form for every unit.
* Diagnose operation problems (binding, sag/deflection, misaligned tracks or bifold supports) and track down problems on doors and frames that won't pass, working with the fabrication lead, and log any rework and its cause.
* Make lists of missing or wrong parts and send them to the office so they get ordered.
* Wrap, package and label passed units, and help load them for delivery. Occasionally help with site service or pickups.
* Keep the QC area organized: store oversized units, lay out the floor, set up the wall and restock supplies.
* Submit The Daily every workday before leaving: units worked, hours per unit, QC result, materials needed and roadblocks. This is part of the job, not extra.

  
What we're looking for  

* 2+ years in window/door installation, glazing, millwork, cabinet or metal fabrication, or similar hands-on assembly.
* Comfortable with hand and power tools (drills, die grinders, sanders, knives, silicone guns).
* Can read shop drawings, a tape measure to 1/16\", and installation guides.
* A detail-oriented, \"it's not done until it's right\" attitude, and the ability to explain clearly what's wrong.
* Asks questions early and goes back to the lead whenever something is unclear.
* Reliable attendance and on-time starts. Can fill out simple phone or tablet forms every day.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus. Experience with steel/aluminum systems or bifolds is a plus.

  
Physical demands  

* Standing, bending, kneeling and reaching for most of the shift.
* Lifting and moving heavy, oversized glass and steel units with a team and lifting equipment. Lifting up to 75 lbs on your own.
* Working with sealants and sanding, using provided PPE (respirator, gloves, eye protection).
* Indoor shop environment, with occasional job-site visits.

  
Schedule and location  
Monday–Friday, 6:30 AM–3:00 PM, at our shop in Vista, CA.
